---
title: 'State of the Ecosystem <br /> `r dplyr::case_when(
  params$region == "MidAtlantic" ~ "Mid-Atlantic",
  params$region == "NewEngland" ~ "New England",
  TRUE ~  "[Mid-Atlantic] *or* [New England]")` 2026'
subtitle: "`r params$council` SSC Update <br /> `r params$date`"
author: "`r params$author`"
editor: source
params:
  region: "Both"
  council: "MAFMC"
  fig_caption: "utils/figure_captions_summary.csv"
  date: !expr Sys.Date() |> format("%B %d, %Y")
  author: "Abigail Tyrell, lead editor, NEFSC"
format:
  # This uses the built-in Quarto revealjs format
  revealjs:
    theme: ""
    footer: "{{< meta footer >}} State of the Ecosystem 2026 | Northeast Fisheries Science Center"
    slide-number: true
    # auto-stretch: false
    # Sets the slide aspect ratio
    # aspect-ratio: 16-9           # Equivalent to ratio: "16:9"
    width: 1600
    height: 900
    margin: 0.1
    min-scale: 0.2
    max-scale: 1.0

    # CSS files for styling
    css:                         # Equivalent to css: [...]
      - libs/EDAB_theme_2026.css
      - libs/cols.css
      
    # Syntax highlighting style
    highlight-style: github      # Equivalent to highlightStyle: githubp (Using Quarto's built-in 'github')
    
    # Allows highlighting specific lines in code blocks
    code-line-numbers: true      # Equivalent to highlightLines: true
    
    # Custom JavaScript files (macros) are included in the header
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <!-- <link href="libs/EDAB_theme_2026.css" rel="stylesheet" /> -->
          <script src="libs/macros.js"></script>
          <script src="libs/cols_macro.js"></script>
          
    # --- Mapped from revealjs::revealjs_presentation ---
    # Controls if resources are embedded or linked
    embed-resources: false       # Equivalent to self_contained: false

    title-slide-attributes:
      # Use the path relative to the .qmd file (project root)
      data-background-image: libs/SOEtitleslide.png
      data-background-size: 60%
      data-background-position: left top
      data-background-class: right-align-title
    
    # --- Other important Quarto options ---
    # This prevents the render process from counting step-by-step reveals as separate slides
    incremental: false           # Equivalent to countIncrementalSlides: false
---

## Discussion Question: Forecasts

Looking for feed back from the SSC on using forecast information in the SOE

\vspace{20mm}

1. We're using deviations from the historical average temperature as the reference point for forecast probabilities. Is this a useful format for the Council?

\vspace{20mm}

2. Are there other "events" or reference points that could be used instead

\vspace{20mm}

3. How should uncertainty be discussed alongside observations? (Measurement error vs forecast uncertainty)

\vspace{20mm}

4. Are there specific research questions or Council decisions that forecasted ocean conditions could assist?
